chunks.text: Hello! I am your American Family Digital Coverage Advisor. I can help you understand your auto and home coverages, deductibles, limits, and bundling discounts. How can I assist you today?

userInput.text: What does 100/300 mean on bodily injury limits?

chunks.text: For 100/300 Bodily Injury limits, the first number ($100,000) is the maximum amount paid per person injured, and the second ($300,000) is the total maximum paid per accident regardless of how many people are injured. A common recommendation is carrying limits at least equal to your net worth to safeguard your assets.
